analysis_plan.primary_estimand: paired offline deterministic-success risk difference: tinykg_jev minus tinykg_lexical
analysis_plan.primary_population: all frozen offline case-trial matches for which both compared arm rows are evaluator-ready; unmatched invalid rows are reported separately and never imputed
analysis_plan.primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar test over matched case-trial pairs at alpha=0.05
analysis_plan.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap risk-difference interval with 10000 resamples, seed 2026080820, clustered by family and trial
secondary_comparisons: tinykg_jev minus no_memory paired offline success
tinykg_lexical minus no_memory paired offline success
secondary_diagnostics: system_one_decision outcomes, actuations, and judged/positive/changed counts per decision kind
scoped recall injected lines and bytes per rollout
evidence precision and recall at k
turns, metered tokens, exposed memory tokens, and cost
system/tools prefix stability, cache reuse, compact, and context projection
analysis_plan.multiplicity: one primary comparison; secondary comparisons and diagnostics are descriptive
analysis_plan.stopping_rule: execute the complete frozen schedule unless a fail-closed budget, credential, binary, sandbox, journal, context-cache, uncontained-tool, or runtime invariant stops before the next provider request; no efficacy stopping
analysis_plan.invalid_rows: retain for audit and exclude from outcome denominators; any differential invalidity blocks promotion to confirmatory evidence
analysis_plan.interpretation: quality_evidence remains false regardless of outcome; the pilot sizes a later confirmatory design and checks that the advisor does not regress procedural transfer

harness.build_command: zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe (the metacodes executable is always ReleaseSmall)

system_one.transport: runner-owned loopback proxy; the child makes no external network call; every exchange is logged by request/response SHA-256 into the rollout artifact tree
system_one.treatment_attestation: a rollout whose judge was consulted but never answered fails closed
system_one.tariff: none (self-hosted); a priced tariff is refused by the client

incident_guard.safely_contained_attempt: continue only when a hash-bound tool result is error=true with permission_denied, safety, recoverable=false
incident_guard.tool_less_breaker_finalization: accept only as the final request with an omitted tools field, exact fixed breaker text, and at least one triggering tool result
incident_guard.uncontained_attempt: fail closed before the next provider request
incident_guard.mid_schedule_failure: persist budget checkpoint before attempting artifact-tree digest, then rethrow
incident_guard.cache_claim: equal zero cache hits, prefix drift, compact, or context projection cannot establish cache preservation

paid_execution_requirements.budget_journal: single-machine locked crash-conservative journal outside the fresh run directory
paid_execution_requirements.credential_transport: private 0600 auth file to anonymous one-shot inherited file descriptor; neither credential nor its fingerprint enters artifacts
paid_execution_requirements.filesystem_isolation: re-observe the macOS Seatbelt production profile and bound negative probes before provider access
paid_execution_requirements.governed_recall: the model-visible KgRecall schema requires lexical_plan; explicit plans and host-scoped recall are separately audited
paid_execution_requirements.local_tinykg: each family, trial, and treatment uses its own fresh isolated local store; no benchmark arm uses the remote harness
paid_execution_requirements.offline_memory_immutability: before credential exposure, prove every offline Markdown and TinyKG root immutable while allowing only the transient TinyKG CLI lock subtree
paid_execution_requirements.remote_tinykg: forbidden for benchmark corpus, trace, receipt, artifact, and store; refined verification only
paid_execution_requirements.semantic_grader: Python registries are checked with AST literal assignment equality without executing candidate code
paid_execution_requirements.tinykg_read_preflight: before budget reservation, the exact pinned TinyKG binary must run store-info and one bounded lexical search inside the production Seatbelt profile and preserve store digests
paid_execution_requirements.tool_result_semantics: only successful memory writes count as mutations; safely denied disallowed-tool attempts remain visible as model tool errors
paid_execution_requirements.toolchain_snapshot: ripgrep is copied to the canonical run-owned 0500 snapshot before provider access
paid_execution_requirements.context_cache: receipt v9 independently reopens native events and raw provider cassettes; cache/context claim gate fails closed on unobserved reuse or any degradation signal

resume_contract.activation: resume is allowed only with the explicit --resume-paid-run flag and is never automatic
resume_contract.contiguous_prefix: the checkpoint must bind the fully verified contiguous schedule prefix and every referenced rollout artifact and receipt
resume_contract.credential_gate: checkpoint, runner, binary, artifact, and journal validation must complete before credential loading
resume_contract.journal_binding: journal identity, revision, head hash, and file hash must exactly match the checkpoint and all referenced transactions must be committed
resume_contract.uncheckpointed_rollout: any rollout directory outside the checkpointed prefix blocks resume
resume_contract.commit_to_checkpoint_ambiguity: a journal advance without a matching verified rollout checkpoint blocks replay; the narrow window is detected, not claimed recoverable

arms.treatment: external memory, host recall, consolidation, and TinyKG retrieval disabled
host-observed episode imported into isolated TinyKG, derived lexical catalog published, scoped recall performed, and model retrieval forced through a replayable lexical query plan

host-observed episode imported into isolated TinyKG, derived lexical catalog published, scoped recall performed, and model retrieval forced through a replayable lexical query plan, plus the System-One (Jev) memory advisor in advisory mode: scoped recall ranks an 8-hit BM25 pool by judge probability plus 0.5 x normalized BM25 once the BM25 floor passes, KgRecall results carry relevance/sufficiency, KgRemember results carry same/contradicts relations, and the enumeration judge arms the soft coverage reminder
